survey: A round wall clock seen almost straight on, maybe turned a few degrees, against a background of vertical green stripes. The thick orange ring frame is very close to a true circle (about 805 px wide and 807 px tall in the enlarged view), and it is about as thick all the way around. It sits flat on the background, and its soft shadow falls down and to the right. The white face is set inside the ring, and its outline is a circle centred in the frame. The 12 hour marks and the minute dots lie on one circle around the face centre. Each mark points toward the centre and sits the same distance from it (about 245–300 px at 12, 3, 6 and 9). The hour, minute and second hands all turn on one central pin with a red cap. The hands lie flat on the face, and the second hand's short tail runs the opposite way along the same straight line. Since the face is seen almost straight on, it is right that the marks and dots are evenly spaced and do not shrink. The ring, the face and the pin all fit that same straight-on view, and the stripes stay vertical.
